title: Smoky Spanish Paella
description: A hearty, smoky Spanish paella dish perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the yellow peas and cook until they start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the yellow, smoky spanish, and split peas, and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the liquid has been absorbed and the peas are tender.
Add the paella and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the paella is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges and parsley if desired.
